input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Retroactive cleanup of committed larch-logs/design/ run dirs.
# Implements issue #3706: apply current exclusion rules historically.
# Guards: skip dirs with pause-state.txt; no git history rewrite.
set -euo pipefail

DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT="${1:-larch-logs/design}"
DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-false}"

if [ ! -d "$DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Returns 0 (excluded/delete) for files matching design_artifact_excluded rules.
# Mirrors design_artifact_excluded() in scripts/design-log-publish.sh.
artifact_excluded() {
  local name="$1"
  case "$name" in
    .design-log-publish-metadata.env|larch-quiet-*-*.log|*.sidecar|*.dirty-tree|\
*.untracked-baseline|*.done|*.diag|*.events.jsonl|*-output.txt.prompt|\
*-output-*.txt.prompt|render-plan-*.prompt|timing-report-final.stderr.log|\
timing-report-final.failure.log)
      return 0 ;;
  esac
  # Rule B: #3705 Phase-1 derived/duplicate artifacts
  case "$name" in
    aggregate-validate.py|findings.md.tmp|composed-plan.redacted.md|ballot.txt)
      return 0 ;;
    *-plan-voter-prompt.txt|aggregator-prompt.md|aggregate-untagged-input.md)
      return 0 ;;
    findings-in-scope.pre-dedup.md|findings-in-scope.pre-aggregation.md)
      return 0 ;;
    scout-plan-manifest.json.raw|scout-plan-manifest.json.raw.prompt)
      return 0 ;;
    *-vote-output.txt.meta|*-vote-output.txt.json)
      return 0 ;;
  esac
  # Rule A: raw plan-review transcripts/diagnostics
  case "$name" in
    cursor-plan-*-output*.txt|codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt|claude-plan-*-output*.txt)
      return 0 ;;
    cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.meta|cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.json|\
cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.cap-hit|cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.tsv|\
cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.launch-stderr|cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.stderr-tail|\
cursor-plan-*-output*.txt.dedup)
      return 0 ;;
    codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.meta|codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.json|\
codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.cap-hit|codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.tsv|\
codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.launch-stderr|codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt.stderr-tail)
      return 0 ;;
    claude-plan-*-output*.txt.meta|claude-plan-*-output*.txt.tsv|\
claude-plan-*-output*.txt.launch-stderr|claude-plan-*-output*.txt.stderr-tail|\
claude-plan-*-output*.txt.stderr|claude-plan-*-output*.txt.jsonl)
      return 0 ;;
    claude-plan-*.prompt|cursor-plan-*-collector.failure.log|\
codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log|dyn-cursor-plan-*-collector.failure.log|\
dyn-codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log|unknown-slot-collector.failure.log|\
plan-review-collector.stderr|plan-review-slots.ndjson.output-files.dropped-slots)
      return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

do_delete() {
  local path="$1"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
    echo "DRY: rm $path"
  else
    rm -f "$path"
  fi
}

do_delete_dir() {
  local path="$1"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
    echo "DRY: rm -rf $path"
  else
    rm -rf "$path"
  fi
}

total_deleted=0
total_dirs=0
skipped_paused=0

# Rider: delete larch-logs/measure-md-cost/ if it exists beside DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT
MEASURE_MD_COST_DIR="${DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT%/design}/measure-md-cost"
if [ -d "$MEASURE_MD_COST_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Rider: deleting $MEASURE_MD_COST_DIR"
  do_delete_dir "$MEASURE_MD_COST_DIR"
fi

for run_dir in "$DESIGN_LOGS_ROOT"/*/; do
  [ -d "$run_dir" ] || continue
  total_dirs=$((total_dirs + 1))

  # Guard: skip paused runs
  if [ -f "${run_dir}pause-state.txt" ]; then
    echo "SKIP (paused): $run_dir"
    skipped_paused=$((skipped_paused + 1))
    continue
  fi

  run_deleted=0

  # --- Top-level files ---
  # Compute the last plan-review round number for Rule C (top-level dedup)
  last_round=0
  if [ -d "${run_dir}plan-review" ]; then
    for rd in "${run_dir}plan-review"/round-*/; do
      [ -d "$rd" ] || continue
      rn="${rd%/}"
      rn="${rn##*/round-}"
      case "$rn" in [0-9]*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
      if [ "$rn" -gt "$last_round" ] 2>/dev/null; then
        last_round="$rn"
      fi
    done
  fi

  # Delete excluded top-level files
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    b=$(basename "$f")
    if artifact_excluded "$b"; then
      do_delete "$f"
      run_deleted=$((run_deleted + 1))
      continue
    fi
    # Rule C: top-level dedup — delete if byte-identical to final round copy
    if [ "$last_round" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
      round_cmp="${run_dir}plan-review/round-${last_round}/${b}"
      if [ -f "$round_cmp" ] && cmp -s "$f" "$round_cmp" 2>/dev/null; then
        do_delete "$f"
        run_deleted=$((run_deleted + 1))
        continue
      fi
    fi
  done < <(find "$run_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)

  # --- plan-review round dirs ---
  if [ -d "${run_dir}plan-review" ]; then
    for round_dir in "${run_dir}plan-review"/round-*/; do
      [ -d "$round_dir" ] || continue
      rn="${round_dir%/}"
      rn="${rn##*/round-}"
      case "$rn" in [0-9]*) ;; *) continue ;; esac

      # Delete revise/ trees entirely
      if [ -d "${round_dir}revise" ]; then
        do_delete_dir "${round_dir}revise"
        run_deleted=$((run_deleted + 1))
      fi

      # Delete round >= 2 plan.txt (Rule B: #3705 round-1-only)
      if [ "$rn" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ -f "${round_dir}plan.txt" ]; then
        do_delete "${round_dir}plan.txt"
        run_deleted=$((run_deleted + 1))
      fi

      # Delete excluded files in round dirs
      while IFS= read -r f; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        b=$(basename "$f")
        if artifact_excluded "$b"; then
          do_delete "$f"
          run_deleted=$((run_deleted + 1))
        fi
      done < <(find "$round_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)
    done
  fi

  if [ "$run_deleted" -gt 0 ]; then
    total_deleted=$((total_deleted + run_deleted))
  fi
done

echo "=== Cleanup complete ==="
echo "Run dirs processed: $total_dirs"
echo "Paused dirs skipped: $skipped_paused"
echo "Files deleted: $total_deleted"
